title: Account Director, Cyber
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) that benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals together in one lab.

Our Go To Market (GTM) team helps customers understand and deploy our highly capable AI products across their businesses. Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnerships work together to bring AI to as many users as possible.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Account Director, Large Enterprise - Cybersecurity, you’ll work with some of our largest cybersecurity customers, winning new business and expanding adoption within existing accounts. You’ll help these organizations apply AI across their products, security workflows, and business operations.

This role combines cybersecurity industry knowledge, technical understanding, executive engagement, and ownership of complex enterprise sales. You’ll create demand, develop opportunities, and lead deals from initial engagement through negotiation, deployment, and expansion. You’ll help executives identify where AI can deliver meaningful value and build a practical path to realizing it.

We’re looking for someone with a hunter mentality and a strong track record in the cybersecurity ecosystem. You’re comfortable engaging CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, product leaders, and other business executives, bringing commercial and technical stakeholders together around an enterprise AI strategy. Success means both winning business and helping customers turn their commitments into sustained adoption and consumption.

This role can be based in our San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle offices. We are also considering applications to work remotely from within the U.S. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL:

- Own a portfolio of large enterprise cybersecurity accounts, developing strategies that drive new business, enterprise adoption, and expansion.

- Create demand through proactive prospecting, executive outreach, and a deep understanding of each customer’s business strategy, product roadmap, and security priorities.

- Own complex deals end to end, including opportunity development, qualification, business case creation, technical evaluation, negotiation, and close.

- Help executives identify opportunities to apply AI across cybersecurity products and workflows, such as security operations, threat analysis, incident response, and security engineering, in partnership with technical specialists.

- Build relationships across security, engineering, product, business operations, and procurement teams, connecting stakeholders around shared goals.

- Partner with solutions engineering to translate technical capabilities into customer programs with measurable business outcomes.

- Navigate customer requirements around data privacy, sensitive security information, governance, and deployment, engaging the appropriate technical, security, and legal partners.

- Win initial deployments and expand successful use cases across teams, business units, and geographies.

- Own a consumption revenue target, partnering across the customer lifecycle to turn signed agreements into production usage and sustained growth.

- Maintain rigorous account plans, opportunity management, and revenue forecasts, taking responsibility for advancing opportunities and resolving obstacles.

- Bring cybersecurity customer and market insights to Product, Engineering, and GTM teams to inform our roadmap and approach.

- Help build the processes, practices, and culture of a growing sales organization.

WE’RE SEEKING SOMEONE WITH EXPERIENCE INCLUDING:

- 14+ years selling complex platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service products to large enterprise customers, with substantial experience in cybersecurity.

- Demonstrated success winning new customers and expanding existing accounts within the cybersecurit

title: Sr. Investigator, Cyber Security
description:
The Senior Investigator role leads and supports investigations involving cyber incidents, insider risk, data loss, unauthorized disclosure, suspicious user activity, employee-related security concerns, high-risk users, and other sensitive matters requiring coordinated handling.
This is an investigation led role. The investigator will triage alerts, scope activity, collect and preserve evidence, correlate technical and behavioral indicators, document findings, brief stakeholders, and recommend proportionate mitigation actions. The role requires incident response judgment, strong documentation, discretion, and working knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR, DLP, identity, endpoint, and threat intelligence tools.
Core Responsibilities
Cyber & Sensitive Investigations

• Lead and support investigations involving cyber incidents, insider-risk alerts, data misuse, policy violations, unauthorized disclosure, suspicious user activity, and other sensitive security matters

• Triage alerts, scope activity, identify affected users, systems, data, and business processes, and determine investigation priority based on risk and impact

• Prepare clear investigation summaries, findings, recommendations, and executive-ready updates for Cyber Security leadership, Legal, HR, Compliance, and business stakeholders

Threat Analysis

• Apply incident response methodology to assess suspicious activity, determine root cause, validate impact, and support containment or remediation actions

• Correlate endpoint, network, identity, cloud, email, and user-behavior evidence to distinguish benign activity from policy violations, compromise, or intentional misuse

• Use threat intelligence and investigative tooling to enrich cases, validate indicators, improve detections, and support proactive risk reduction

Insider Risk Detection & Management

• Identify and assess insider-risk indicators across DLP, UEBA, identity, endpoint, cloud, collaboration, and security monitoring platforms

• Investigate potential data exfiltration, unauthorized access, abnormal file movement, misuse of sensitive information, and risky behavior by employees, contractors, or privileged users

• Monitor high-risk scenarios including employee departures, role changes, privileged access, high-risk travel, sensitive projects, and repeat policy violations

Case Management, Evidence & Documentation

• Maintain complete case documentation from intake through closure, including timeline, evidence sources, investigative actions, findings, risk assessment, and mitigation decisions

• Preserve evidence integrity and maintain chain of custody where required for cyber, employee, legal, or compliance-sensitive matters

• Ensure cases are handled confidentially, consistently, and in alignment with company policy, privacy expectations, legal guidance, and HR direction

Cross-Functional Coordination & Mitigation

• Serve as a trusted investigation partner to Cyber Security, Legal, HR, Compliance, IT, business leadership, and other stakeholders involved in sensitive cases

• Coordinate escalation, containment, access changes, monitoring, employee action, clean-device workflows, post-travel review, or other mitigation steps with the appropriate owners

• Translate technical findings into clear business risk language for non-technical stakeholders while preserving investigative accurac

• Experience in incident response, security operations, cyber investigations, threat intelligence, insider-risk investigations, or sensitive security matters with a focus on APT groups.

• Hands-on familiarity with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, DLP, case management, identity, endpoint, cloud, and threat intelligence platforms

• Experience briefing technical and non-technical stakeholders, including Cyber Security leadership, Legal, HR, Compliance, and executive audiences

• Background in operations security, information security, personnel security, physical security, intelligence, compliance, or security program management

• Strong written

title: Senior Director, CEO Communications

description:

title: Lead, Safety Assurance
description:
May Mobility is transforming cities through autonomous technology to create a safer, greener, more accessible world. Based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, May develops and deploys autonomous vehicles (AVs) powered by our innovative Multi-Policy Decision Making (MPDM) technology that literally reimagines the way AVs think.

Our vehicles do more than just drive themselves - they provide value to communities, bridge public transit gaps and move people where they need to go safely, easily and with a lot more fun. We’re building the world’s best autonomy system to reimagine transit by minimizing congestion, expanding access and encouraging better land use in order to foster more green, vibrant and livable spaces. Since our founding in 2017, we’ve given more than 500,000 autonomous rides to real people around the globe. And we’re just getting started. We’re hiring people who share our passion for building the future, today, solving real-world problems and seeing the impact of their work. Join us.

Job Summary
May Mobility is seeking a Lead, Safety Assurance to serve as the company's primary authority on autonomous vehicle safety compliance. Reporting to the Legal team and supporting the engineering safety team, this senior subject matter expert role operates independently from the engineering Safety organization to provide an objective, compliance-anchored perspective on May Mobility 's safety posture. This person will lead regulatory engagement on safety matters end-to-end-from monitoring emerging federal and state requirements to leading NHTSA correspondence, reviewing SGO incident narratives, and maintaining the compliance documentation that underpins May Mobility 's ability to operate and expand.
This role requires someone who combines deep regulatory expertise with firsthand knowledge of how federal safety frameworks apply in practice-and who can translate that knowledge into durable internal processes appropriate in an agile startup environment, credible external submissions, and sound counsel to Safety and Legal leadership.
Essential Responsibilities
NHTSA & SGO Leadership

• Review, quality-assure, and approve SGO incident narratives prior to submission, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and appropriate framing

• Monitor NHTSA and state enforcement trends, proposed rulemakings, safety guidance, and regulatory developments at the state and federal levels; proactively surface implications to Safety and Legal leadership

• Support responses to NHTSA investigations or enforcement actions, coordinating with outside counsel and internal stakeholders as needed

Regulatory Compliance & Gap Analysis

• Monitor federal and state AV regulatory requirements and assess alignment with May Mobility ’s internal safety policies, identifying gaps where internal standards fall short of the regulatory floor

• Support development of internal safety benchmarks, including review of the company SMS calibrated against applicable federal standards, including FMVSS, NHTSA frameworks, SAE standards, and other industry best practices

• Participate in enterprise risk management activities with a regulatory consequence lens, assessing whether identified operational risks carry regulatory implications

• Track emerging ADS-related guidance, enforcement trends, and state-level rulemakings; maintain a current regulatory landscape view for leadership

Compliance Documentation & Submissions

• Create and maintain a comprehensive library of compliance documentation, including regulatory context summaries, gap analyses, submission records, and background materials

• Prepare and review safety-relevant regulatory submissions and correspondence, ensuring accuracy of safety content and appropriate routing through Legal prior to submission

• Prepare supporting documentation for regulatory engagements where safety posture is relevant, including materials for meetings with state DOTs, federal agencies, and other stakeholders

Safety Assurance & Cross-Functional Advisory

title: Director, AI & Data Science
description:
DIRECTOR, AI & DATA SCIENCE
Data Engineering & Analytics, AI, and Data Science | Full-Time, Salaried | Player-Coach | Reports to the Co-CEOs

Company

Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location

Remote, anywhere in the USA

Team

Six to seven individual contributors across data engineering, analytics, data science, ML, and MLOps

Education

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field required. Master’s or PhD preferred.

Compensation

$175,000 to $225,000 base

Schedule

Collaboration across time zones. Regular working-hour overlap with our Singapore Dev team and partners is required.

Travel

Required for team weeks and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role
Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are a lean company of about 60 people, so every leader here builds.
You will lead our combined Data Engineering & Analytics, AI, and Data Science team of six to seven individual contributors and report directly to the Co-CEOs. This team is Seeking's central AI capability: the models, infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and continuous-learning systems the whole company runs on. Expect about half your time leading and half writing code, building models, and debugging production systems yourself.
Your first mandate is to achieve 100% AI automation of routine user-uploaded content moderation, with accuracy proven superior to our human moderators and at a lower total cost. Next is AI customer support that resolves member tickets end to end. You own both outcomes completely, from policy and data through production results.
Over time, the team will extend AI to fraud prevention, matching, member onboarding and success, marketing, monetization, retention, and product development, in partnership with the leaders who own those areas. Every initiative carries a measurable target, a named owner, and a mechanism for continuous learning. The immediate problems come first, and this role exists to solve them.
This role is for someone who manages a hands-on team today and still ships code. If your recent roles had managers reporting to you, or you plan to delegate the technical work and manage through status meetings, this is the wrong role. If you walk into ambiguity and know exactly what to do, keep reading.
What You Will Do
1. Set the foundation in your first 30 days

• Bring Product, Support, and Operations to one written moderation policy with a single owner. When teams disagree, you run the process that settles it.

• Inventory every production AI system with a named owner, backup, dependencies, and monitoring gaps.

• Trace every upload from receipt through model decision, enforcement, and any human review. Quantify every path that still needs a human, with its root cause, cost, and fix.

2. Prove AI beats our human moderators, then reach 100%

• Test the AI and our moderators on the same held-out cases, with reference decisions set by independent, policy-qualified reviewers. Report missed violations and wrongful rejections separately, with sample sizes and confidence intervals.

• Close every gap: missing coverage, uncertain model outputs, system failures, unenforced decisions, and duplicate human review. Expand automation in controlled stages, each with a tested rollback.

3. Build systems that keep getting better

• Every production system improves through verified feedback, independent evaluation, and controlled releases. Run a monthly learning cycle in which a new model ships only when it beats production on the same independent test.

• Version every dataset, policy, prompt, and model so every gain can be proven and every change can be rolled back.

4. Run production AI like a business

• Give every production AI system monitoring, alerts to a named owner, documented recovery, and regular failure drills.

• Report results in business terms: quality, cost per outcome, revenue, efficiency, and member experience, with savings reconciled with Finance.

title: Senior Actuarial Analyst
description:
About the Role
Location: Fully remote within the continental United States.
Use of AI data in insurance pricing entails regulatory review by state departments of insurance. When a carrier intends to use Nearmap data in its rates, both the carrier’s own actuaries and state insurance regulators can come back with various questions and/or objections. Many are predictable and specific: how was ground truth for an attribute determined, what do the goodness-of-fit metrics look like on held-out data? Others have never been asked before and have yet to be fully answered.
You will be the actuarial voice inside Nearmap ’s and our customers’ rate filings. Working with our AI and Computer Vision team, you will build a library of validation materials behind every Nearmap attribute and score used in rating, produce exhibits and memos for state DOI review, and answer regulator objections with analysis that holds up under scrutiny.
This is a customer-facing actuarial role, not a back-office one. You will report into Insurance Product and work alongside our regulatory affairs owner, who owns regulator relationships and submission mechanics, so your time goes to the analysis and the defense of it.
Key Responsibilities
You’ll own and defend the filing evidence:

• Coordinate on and collaborate with cross functional teams to produce the filing materials for each Nearmap attribute and score used in rating: model memos, validation and accuracy metrics, and the actuarial exhibits that go into a submission.

• Document and maintain what each state requires for model validation, including details on state-by-state confidentiality and trade secret treatments, ensuring Nearmap consistently produces exhibits that satisfies the NAIC checklist for model filings

• Turn model outputs into the evidence that filings need, such as model validation metrics, coverage rates, distributional analysis, bias and fairness testing, and by-state breakdowns. Lead the analytical response to regulator objections, working with our regulatory affairs owner on strategy, framing, and submission, and join calls with departments of insurance to explain methodology and results directly.

• Manage administration of Nearmap ’s filings including creating and maintaining SERFF accounts and keeping good records of all Nearmap filing materials and exchanges.

You'll work directly with customers:

• Advise on which attributes are filing-ready and which carry approval risk and build supporting materials to enable the GTM teams and customers ahead of time.

• Partner with carrier actuarial and pricing teams on how Nearmap data is best implemented in their rating plans.

• Collaborate with pre-sales to support data tests and lift analyses that demonstrate predictive value and help turn the results into something a filing can use.

You'll make the next filing cheaper than the last:

• Build reusable validation templates and exhibits so each new carrier program costs less effort than the one before it.

• Establish product requirements for new products and scores before they ship that makes them “filing ready” immediately upon release.

Experience

• 5+ years of property and casualty actuarial experience, with real exposure to pricing, ratemaking, or rate filings.

• ACAS or FCAS credentialing strongly preferred for this role. Candidates with substantial ratemaking and filing experience will be considered.

• Experience preparing actuarial exhibits for rate filings and responding to regulator objections.

• Bachelor's degree in actuarial science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related field.

Skills

• You can explain carrier-led rate filing processes to someone who is not an actuary without making them feel lost.

• You are comfortable with predictive model output, including GLMs, gradient boosting, and the validation statistics that go with them.

• You have worked with large claims and exposure data using standard tooling including SQL, R, or Python.

title: Software Engineer, TPU Compilers
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Inference team brings OpenAI’s most capable research and technology to the world through our products. We empower consumers, enterprises and developers alike to use and access our state-of-the-art AI models, allowing them to do things that they’ve never been able to before. We focus on performant and efficient model inference, as well as accelerating research progression via model inference.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an engineer to lead the optimization of OpenAI’s state-of-the-art frontier models on TPUs. You will own performance across the full forward pass, from model code through kernels to execution on the hardware.

You’ll have broad technical ownership: identifying performance bottlenecks, choosing the most impactful improvements, and carrying them through implementation and validation. We welcome experience gained through either training or inference, with a strong foundation in optimizing real workloads on TPUs.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Optimize model execution on TPUs, improving performance across the complete forward pass and the interactions between model code, kernels, and hardware.

- Profile workloads, identify bottlenecks, and implement improvements to latency, throughput, and hardware utilization.

- Develop and optimize kernels, using an understanding of the surrounding model to guide implementation choices.

- Explore techniques such as quantization to improve inference efficiency while preserving model quality.

- Build benchmarks and tools to measure performance, validate correctness, and guide optimization work.

- Partner with researchers and engineers to support new model architectures and bring performance improvements into production.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have practical experience optimizing machine learning workloads on TPUs, through training, inference, or both.

- Understand modern model architectures and how their computation maps onto accelerator hardware.

- Can connect detailed kernel behavior to the performance of a complete model and work across these layers of the stack.

- Bring strong software engineering skills and a systematic approach to profiling, debugging, and validating performance improvements.

- Take ownership of open-ended technical problems and can identify priorities, make design decisions, and deliver working solutions.

- Enjoys collaborating with researchers and engineers, learning unfamiliar parts of a system, and communicating technical tradeoffs.

- Have experience with quantization or attention kernels, which would be especially useful in this role.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. Fundingo is a loan servicing platform built natively on Salesforce. Our customers are lenders and loan servicers who use Fundingo to run their day-to-day operations. Our delivery team works directly with those customers, building custom implementations, integrations, and data migrations that fit Fundingo to how each customer runs their business.

• Build scalable and performant implementations using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce tools.

title: Software Engineer — Full-Stack (.NET / Java / Python / React)
description:
About CompSci
CompSci LLC is a hybrid onshore/nearshore technology services firm with about 100 people working across roughly 22 active client engagements. Our engineers embed with client teams in healthcare, education, insurance, and SaaS, building new products and modernizing the systems those businesses run on.
We treat AI-assisted and agentic development as a core part of how we deliver, not an experiment. Engineers here work with defined standards, automated quality gates, and modern pipelines.
The role
We're hiring a full-stack software engineer who is productive across several stacks: .NET/C#, Java, Python, React, and relational databases. You'll be placed on a client engagement and may move between engagements over time, so range matters as much as depth.
Some projects are greenfield. Others are long-lived platforms on older frameworks, including .NET Framework 4.x and ASP.NET Web Forms, that need careful modernization. We want someone equally comfortable in both.

• Type: Full-time, W-2 with standard benefits

• Location: Remote; US or nearshore (Latin America)

• Hours: Substantial overlap with US Central Time

• English: Professional fluency, spoken and written; you'll work directly with US clients

What you'll do

• Design, build, and maintain backend services in C#/.NET, Java, and Python, and front ends in React with TypeScript.

• Model data, write efficient SQL, and tune queries and schemas for SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.

• Modernize legacy applications incrementally, keeping production stable while moving to current frameworks.

• Build and consume REST APIs and integrations with third-party and partner systems.

• Use AI coding tools and agents within our team standards, and review their output with the same rigor as human code.

• Write unit and integration tests, and keep CI/CD pipelines green.

• Deploy to and troubleshoot cloud environments, primarily AWS, with some Azure.

• Work directly with client stakeholders: clarify requirements, estimate work, and explain trade-offs in plain language.

• Review peers' code and mentor less experienced engineers.

Required qualifications

• 5+ years of professional software development, shipping production code.

• .NET/C#: Production experience with modern .NET (6 or later), plus working familiarity with .NET Framework.

• Java: Production experience, ideally with Spring or Spring Boot.

• Python: Comfortable writing services, scripts, and data tooling.

• React: Strong React with TypeScript, including state management and component design.

• Databases: Solid SQL and relational design, with SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL in production.

• Hands-on use of AI coding assistants in daily work, with a clear view of where they help and where they fail.

• Automated testing (for example xUnit, JUnit, pytest, Jest) and Git-based CI/CD workflows.

• Clear communication in English with technical and non-technical people.

We don't expect equal depth in every language. We do expect you to be productive in all of them and expert in at least two.
Nice to have

• Legacy migrations, such as Web Forms or WCF to ASP.NET Core, or a monolith to services.

• Next.js, Node.js, or NestJS.

• AWS infrastructure as code (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform), plus Docker.

• NoSQL or caching layers such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, or Redis.

• Regulated domains: healthcare (HIPAA, EHR), education, or insurance.

• Experience building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

• Technical leadership: leading a small team, running design reviews, or interviewing engineers.

• Code quality and security tooling such as SonarQube or SAST scanners.

What we offer

• Your choice of full-time W-2 employment with standard benefits or a 1099 contract arrangement.

• Compensation set by experience and geographic region.

• Real variety: different clients, domains, and stacks, with room to move between engagements.

• An engineering culture that takes AI-assisted developme

title: Media Buyer RO
description:
About HIGHSCALE

We're HIGHSCALE , a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing how brands advertise on TV and social media. Think Amazon's customer obsession meets SpaceX's fearless innovation.
Our 120-person team spans creatives, strategists, editors, and analysts, powering thousands of high-performance video ads for lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands every week. With 50,000 sq. ft. of studios in DTLA and an international network of creators and influencers, we're scaling fast, and we're building our media buying team in Romania to help us amplify that growth across global markets.
Why This Role Matters
Every viral campaign starts with precision targeting and flawless media execution. As a Media Buyer, you'll turn creative excellence into performance results, deploying millions in ad spend across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms for US brands.
You'll combine analytical rigor with creative intuition, ensuring every dollar spent fuels data-driven learning and exponential brand growth.
What You'll Do
Launch & Optimize Campaigns

• Plan, execute, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other digital platforms.

• Manage budgets, bidding strategies, and audience targeting to maximize ROI.

• Continuously A/B test creatives, audiences, and placements to identify scalable winners.

Analyze & Report Performance

• Track and interpret campaign data daily to identify performance trends.

• Build and present reports highlighting insights, learnings, and optimization strategies.

• Translate numbers into actionable strategies for creative and strategy teams.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

• Work closely with creative, production, and strategy teams to ensure ads are optimized for performance and storytelling.

• Provide feedback loops between creative and data, informing what works and what doesn't.

• Support the strategy team in developing media plans and client recommendations.

Scale Efficiently

• Manage and scale ad accounts with 5 to 6 figures in monthly spend.

• Identify growth opportunities and emerging channels to stay ahead of the competition.

• Proactively propose testing strategies and budget reallocations to maximize performance.

Stay Ahead of Trends

• Keep up to date with algorithm updates, platform best practices, and performance marketing innovations.

• Experiment with new ad formats and beta programs to drive early adopter advantage.

Who You Are
Performance-Driven

• 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns.

• Proven track record in performance marketing, ideally for eCommerce, fashion, or beauty brands.

• Strong analytical skills: comfortable reading metrics, building reports, and identifying growth levers.

Data-Savvy

• Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Google Ads, and analytics tools.

• Bonus: hands-on experience with Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, DSP) or full Amazon listing management.

• Bonus: DV360 or other programmatic platform experience.

Creative & Strategic

• Understands what makes content perform: able to connect audience psychology with ad messaging.

• Loves blending storytelling with numbers to drive conversions.

Fast & Adaptable

• Thrives in a high-speed environment where priorities shift daily.

• Excels at managing multiple campaigns and deadlines with precision.

Collaborative & Communicative

• Excellent communication skills in English.

• Based in Romania and available to work 9am to 6pm PST, Monday to Friday, alongside our LA team.

Perks & Benefits

• Remote Role: Work with global teams from anywhere in Romania.

• Growth Opportunities: Chance to lead media buying strategy for global DTC brands as we build out the Romanian team.

• Profit-Sharing & Stock Options: Be part of our shared success as we scale.

• Continuous Learning: Access to training, workshops, and tools that sharpen your analytical and creative edge.

title: Customer Support Representative (financial background)
description:
Join Hire Hangar and work with fast-growing global companies while building a long-term career.

Role Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented Customer Support Representative with a strong financial background to join a fast-growing U.S.-based fintech company. The company offers a cashback and payments app that lets users earn money back on everyday purchases by buying instant digital gift cards at checkout. In this role, you will support customers and partners on account, payment, and transaction inquiries, including high-value money movements, and deliver accurate, timely resolutions that build trust in the platform. If you are comfortable handling large sums with precision and care and you thrive in a fast-paced, customer-first environment, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

- Respond to inbound customer inquiries via email, chat, and ticketing platform with accurate, timely, and professional resolutions.

- Investigate and resolve issues related to payments, cashback rewards, gift card purchases, refunds, and account balances.

- Support and monitor high-value transactions and money movements, including seven-figure sums, with strict attention to accuracy and compliance.

- Identify, flag, and escalate suspicious activity, potential fraud, or transaction discrepancies to the appropriate internal teams.

- Reconcile transaction records and verify payment details to make sure customer accounts are accurate and up to date.

- Document all interactions, resolutions, and recurring issues thoroughly in the support system.

- Collaborate with finance, risk, and product teams to resolve complex cases and improve support processes.

- Contribute to the internal knowledge base by capturing common fixes, FAQs, and workflow improvements.

- Maintain a high standard of professionalism, empathy, and clear communication throughout the customer journey.

Required Qualifications

- Proven customer support experience within financial services, fintech, banking, or payments.

- Demonstrated experience handling large money movements, including seven-figure transactions, with a high degree of accuracy.

- Strong understanding of payment processing, transaction flows, refunds, chargebacks, and account reconciliation.

- Excellent attention to detail and sound judgment when handling sensitive financial information.

- Proficient written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable working with ticketing systems, CRMs, and internal financial tools.

- Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and manage a steady volume of inquiries.

- Availability to work during U.S. business hours.

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with AML, KYC, and fraud prevention practices.

- Experience with support platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, or similar.

- Background in e-commerce, rewards programs, or digital gift card platforms.

- Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets for transaction tracking and reporting.

title: Open Role
description:
About the Role
This is not a posting for one job. It's an open door for builders who want in on what we're doing.
Every hire crosses a line. Before the offer, the work is finding the right person. After the offer, the work has to be right: identity, work authorization, background checks, tax forms, union agreements, credentials. Someone's name is on every one of them. AI agents are taking over the first half. Nobody is taking the accountability for the second. That's us.
Onboarded is the API for the workflows that have to be right. We never built I-9 as a feature. We built primitives: an ontology of the worker, the job, the client and the employer, forms written as code, policies kept current, automations that react when a fact changes. More than six million workers have become eligible for work on that engine. Some of the largest HR tech platforms in the world run on it under their own brand. And it's starting to run work that has nothing to do with onboarding at all.
An agent can decide. An agent cannot be liable. Every hiring agent being built right now needs a deterministic, auditable layer underneath it. We're building that layer, and we're a small team doing it. If you've read this far and thought "I want to build that," we want to hear from you, even if no role on our careers page fits.
What You'll Do
We hire for the person first and shape the seat around what you're great at. Here's the work that needs doing:
Build the engine. Extend the ontology, the policy engine and the automations framework. Make agents first-class callers through our APIs and MCP server.
Build the agent that writes configuration. Turn a policy, a union contract or a customer request into config a human reviews and ships. This is how a small team serves a big market.
Deploy into the field. Embed with customers and partners and build their compliance workflows as code. Everyone here gets close to the people who use what we build.
Grow the ecosystem. Open doors with the hiring platforms, staffing systems and HR software companies that distribute Onboarded, and turn signed partnerships into live customers.
Tell the story. Define a category in public. Write, ship, film and teach how the work that has to be right gets done in the agent era.
Make developers love it. Build the sandbox, the quickstart, the docs and the open-source packages that let a developer ship compliant onboarding in ten minutes.
What We're Looking For
Titles and pedigree matter less here than how you work. Every person at Onboarded shares a few things:
You build. Code, systems, partnerships, stories, whatever your craft is. You'd rather ship something real this week than plan something perfect next quarter.
AI is how you work. You use AI tools as a force multiplier every day, whatever your role. This is non-negotiable.
You care about getting it right. Our work decides whether a real person starts their job on time and compliantly. You know the difference between fast and right, and you deliver both.
You own outcomes, not tasks. If you see it, you own it. Nobody routes it to you.
You get close to the customer. You'd rather sit with the people using the product than guess what they need.
You say it plainly. Short sentences. Conviction first. Clearly wrong and corrected beats vaguely right.
Experience in HR tech, staffing, payroll, developer platforms or employment compliance is a strong signal but not required. Learning velocity counts just as much.
This is not a fit for someone who wants a defined lane, a long ramp, or a big company's structure. It is for builders who want to own something that matters, early.
Why Onboarded
The timing is now. Agents are rewriting how hiring works, and every one of them needs a layer it can trust underneath. We're already that layer for millions of workers. The next few years decide who owns it.
Your work ships and it matters. A small team means everything you build reaches production and real people. No layers between you and the outcome.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. - Language fluency - English fluency (both written and spoken) is essential, while knowledge of Italian or French is a plus for effective communication within our international context.

Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

• 3D CAD proficiency (any platform) and ability to understand and apply GD&T to create high quality engineering drawings.

LMcare is een no-nonsense GGZ-instelling die psychische zorg voor volwassenen in een nieuw jasje steekt. Laagdrempelig en zonder stoffige bureaucratie. title: Procurement Officer
description:
KAIZEN is seeking a qualified, detail-oriented, and commercially astute professional for the position of Procurement Officer. This is a full-time, remote-based role responsible for the strategic sourcing, tendering, contract administration, and regulatory compliance of all procurement activities in support of the organisation’s real estate portfolio.
Position Overview
The Procurement Officer shall evaluate suppliers, products, and services, negotiate and administer contracts, and ensure that all procurement activities deliver cost-effective, high-quality outcomes in a timely manner. The role is pivotal in safeguarding organisational budgets, driving operational profitability, and upholding the integrity of procurement governance and regulatory adherence.
Key Responsibilities

•
Sourcing and Contract Award Source, assess, and award contracts to duly licensed and qualified contractors, suppliers, and service providers for the provision of goods, works, and services, in strict accordance with established organisational policies, procedures, and governance principles. Ensure all procurement processes are executed within approved timelines from receipt of request through to proposal receipt and contract award.

•
Tendering and Proposal Evaluation Prepare, issue, and manage tender documentation for Annual Maintenance Contracts across all KAIZEN-managed properties. Conduct systematic comparative analysis and evaluation of submitted proposals, ensuring objectivity, transparency, and alignment with cost, quality, and delivery criteria. Maintain a minimum compliance rate of ninety percent for tender evaluations completed in full accordance with prescribed process.

•
Contract and Vendor Performance Management Establish and maintain robust monitoring frameworks to assess contractor and supplier performance against contractual terms and deliverables. Identify deficiencies, non-conformities, or deviations in contract execution and initiate and coordinate timely corrective and remedial actions. Maintain accurate contract records, status updates, and performance reports using approved management systems and tools. Achieve and sustain a minimum Procurement Audit Report score of ninety percent.

•
Compliance, Regulation, and Reporting Ensure full and ongoing adherence to the regulations of the Dubai Real Estate Regulatory Agency, the provisions of UAE Law No. 6 of 2019, applicable health and safety standards, and all internal procurement policies. Prepare, validate, and submit accurate procurement documentation, compliance records, audit trails, and performance reports as required. Achieve and sustain a minimum Procurement Audit Report score of ninety percent.

Requirements

• Proven procurement experience, preferably within real estate, property management, facilities management, construction, or related industries.

• Strong knowledge of procurement processes, tender management, contract administration, vendor management, and cost analysis.

• Knowledge of UAE procurement regulations and RERA requirements is an advantage but not mandatory.

• Fluency in Arabic is essential, with strong English communication skills.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and process-driven, with a strong focus on compliance, documentation, and audit readiness.

• Must be genuinely interested in and comfortable with a fully remote working arrangement, with the ability to work independently and maintain productivity without direct supervision.

• Demonstrates self-discipline, accountability, reliability, and excellent time management.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and digital collaboration tools.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with vendors, colleagues, and stakeholders across different locations.

title: Client Engagement Manager
description:
The Client Engagement Manager is the gatekeeper of Product and Services resources for strategic ERP opportunities, partnering with Account Executives from early-stage discovery through Statement of Work execution and hand-off to Delivery. This role owns solution scoping, deal economics, and commercial structuring for QAD Adaptive ERP and Champion AI engagements, ensuring every proposal is grounded in disciplined discovery, priced to protect margin, and staffed for predictable delivery. Acting as the primary Professional Services counterpart to Sales, the Client Engagement Manager balances competitiveness with commercial rigor and ensures a clean transition from sales engagement to project execution.

Pre-Sales Discovery & Solution Scoping

• Support the AE in architecting the solution and defining services components (deliverables, timeline, effort), incorporating Solutions Engineering input on technical feasibility and dependencies.

SOW Development & Commercial Structuring

• Draft and validate Statements of Work in partnership with the AE, defining scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

Delivery Hand-Off & Continuity

• Co-lead the hand-off from Sales to Services Delivery, ensuring the delivery team receives a complete, validated SOW and supporting discovery artifacts.

• Act as an escalation point for pre-sales misalignment or scope disputes prior to project kick-off.

• Partner with Delivery leadership to feed field learnings back into scoping standards and estimation models.

Experience

• Strong commercial acumen: pricing strategy, margin protection, forecasting, and contract structuring.

• Proficiency with CRM/CPQ tooling (e.g., Salesforce) and services estimation tools.

• Executive-level written and verbal communication skills.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree a plus.
